summary: Refine the Human-AI collaboration operationalization with a candidate work-type semantic contract that distinguishes iteration, preflight, review/re-review, correction, promotion, admission, reconciliation, persistence/operationalization slice and implementation slice by evidence, authority, staleness and follow-up consequences; preserve current P2 scope and all canonical authority boundaries.

requirements.rationale: The operationalization snapshot maps current real-use gaps to existing Requirements without changing Requirement text, criticality or authority. Future activation may re-evaluate whether refinement is needed.

issues_findings.rationale: The detailed audit remains the primary semantic evidence. The new human-readable and machine-readable snapshots preserve seven peer axes, evidence maturity, activation semantics, omissions and restart instructions without creating seven premature work items. A repeated same-chat misuse of the term iteration after prior Human correction is now captured as additional OC-07 real-use evidence.

risks.rationale: The operationalization explicitly mitigates drift, authority creep, false completion, state duplication and meta-work risks by separating candidate identity, activation, execution priority, admission and demonstrated capability maturity.

decisions_concepts.rationale: Candidate work-type semantics now bind terminology to operational consequences: required evidence, authority created (if any), stale evidence, next obligations and explicit non-consequences. This remains inside PR #37 candidate planning evidence; system/lifecycle.json and system/authority.json are unchanged pending independent qualitative review and later promotion decision.

derived_views.rationale: Refresh only the reconciliation provenance of the generated current-state view; baseline counts and execution authority remain unchanged.

planning_execution_cursor.rationale: Work-type semantics do not manufacture priority or execution permission. Current P2 preflight remains complete, p2-implementation-admission remains the separate blocked Human gate, implementation_allowed remains false, and the P2 scope is unchanged.

active_work.rationale: No OC axis, work-type contract, or P2 implementation is activated as implementation work by this semantic refinement.
